title: 30A Dreamin' | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 30A Dreamin’, where laid-back coastal living meets elevated comfort for the ultimate getaway along 30A. Designed with families and groups in mind, this beautiful retreat comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests and offers the perfect combination of space, relaxation, and entertainment. With a private pool, outdoor fireplace, spacious bedrooms, and a dedicated bunk room, 30A Dreamin’ has everything you need to settle in, slow down, and make unforgettable memories together.Inside, you’ll find bright, welcoming living spaces filled with coastal charm and thoughtful touches throughout. The open-concept layout makes gathering effortless, whether you’re enjoying slow mornings over coffee, preparing meals in the fully equipped kitchen, or relaxing together after a sun-filled day. The king ensuite provides a peaceful private retreat, while the dedicated bunk room offers a fun and comfortable space that younger guests are sure to love.Step outside and discover your own private backyard oasis. Spend sunny Florida afternoons cooling off in the sparkling private pool, lounge poolside with your favorite drink, or gather together as the evening winds down. The outdoor fireplace creates the perfect setting for cozy nights under the stars, whether you’re sharing stories, enjoying a glass of wine, or simply soaking in the relaxed 30A atmosphere.When you’re ready to venture out, you’ll be perfectly positioned to enjoy everything that makes 30A so special. Spend your days along the sugar-white sand and emerald waters, explore nearby coastal communities, discover local restaurants and boutiques, or simply take your time enjoying the laid-back beach lifestyle.Whether you’re planning a family vacation, a getaway with friends, or a multi-generational trip, 30A Dreamin’ offers the space and amenities to make your stay feel effortless. From pool days and beach adventures to cozy evenings by the outdoor fireplace, this is the kind of place where vacation memories are made and you’ll already be dreaming about your next stay before you leave.HOME HIGHLIGHTSShort Bike Ride to the Beach6 Seater Golf CartPrivate Saltwater Pool *Pool heating/cooling available for $50 per dayPrivate Covered Patio with Outdoor SeatingGas Grill6 Adult bikesClose to Seaside & Grayton BeachFully Equipped Gourmet KitchenSmart TVsBeach Gear including Pool Towels, Chairs, Umbrellas, Toys & Coolers4 Dedicated Parking SpotsFull Sized Washer and DryerFenced in YardBunk BedsACCOMMODATIONSSleeps: 10FIRST FLOORLiving- Flex Room (queen sofa sleeper)-Kitchen-Dining-LaundryBedroom 1: King with Ensuite featuring a walk in showerBedroom 2: QueenHall bathroomSECOND FLOORBedroom 3: KingBedroom 4: (2) Twin/Twin built-in bunksHall BathroomLiving RoomWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee GroundsCoffee Filters2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGFour driveway parking spaces available. *Garage is not forIncluded are 6 bicycles (adult) & 6 seater golf cart for your convenience.BEACH ACCESSThree public beach accesses a short distance from the home:1. Gulfview Heights Beach Access is located 3 miles east of the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A (Gulf Place). Turn south off Scenic 30A by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street, then 1/4 mile to the gulf. This access has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season.2. Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is located at the intersection of Scenic 393 and Scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, just across the street from Gulf Place rentals, shopping, and dining. This access is ADA accessible, and has two picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs and lifeguards during peak season. Ed Walline Regional Access is unique among SoWal accesses with a two-story viewing platform overlooking the beach and gulf - a great place to spot surfers and dolphins.3. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal.BLUE MOUNTAIN COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSBlue Mountain is a laid-back coastal gem celebrated for its natural beauty, relaxed pace, and small-town charm. As the highest elevation along Scenic Highway 30A, it offers scenic dune views, peaceful beaches, and some of the most stunning sunsets on the Gulf.The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience.Just a short bike or golf cart ride away is Gulf Place. A beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach.When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience.Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. For sunset strolls and inspiring views, drift down to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. With ample parking, restrooms, bike racks and proximity to lifeguards in season, it couldn’t be more welcoming.Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a 40 minute drive.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid driver's license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.*Private Heated Pool **Pool heating/cooling is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Must be heated for duration of stay. If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi.*Home must remain pet free.*No guest parking in garage. Garage is for golf cart.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
